title: A row read at its position, then an answer at the same position from before the read: the row stays read; a later message past the read counts
why: Opening a row reads it through its position (readSeq 101). A refresh the server computed before that read lands with the same position and the old unread: everything it counted is at or below the read, so it is dropped. An answer at 102 has a message past the read, so its unread stands (read_covers_only_its_activity).
